subject: Disposition of decision 0006's 39 declared-access cases, their 19 recorded production gaps and two limitations under decision 0012. The historical files are unchanged; their digests pin what was disposed.

kinds.structural: A requirement of the full tree itself: construction, selection, own capability identity, exact keys, missing versus refusing nodes, decomposition and reconstruction. Evidence runs with no carrier.
kinds.bridge: A requirement of the explicit mapping from a tree to the unchanged addressed carrier surface (AsAddressed/asAddressed): the exact UTF-8 image, refusal before any primitive, send-only access.
kinds.carrier: A requirement of full trees composed across bitruntime carriers: a tree served on an endpoint and a declared tree whose own Wires are bound to carrier paths, on the local pair and on real WebSockets in both directions, including replies, cancellation, relays, addressed mounts and teardown.
kinds.historical-addressed: An observation that depended on decision 0006's addressed interpretation. It stays valid evidence about AddressedWire operators and is not a WireTree requirement.

limitations.suffix-delivery: An opaque child access received the remaining relative path, so [alias, x] reached leaf with [x]. In 0.3 every node's own Wire is addressless and a tree path names nodes only: a path beyond a node without that child is missing. Suffix delivery survives only as AddressedWire prefix binding (bitruntime At/at, Mount/mount), which decision 0012 says is not structural selection.
limitations.path-observing-interception: A guard wrapped addressed access, saw every relative path and could refuse before any destination. An own Wire never sees a path. Interception inside a tree is a wrapped own primitive, whose retained state the structural cases cover; interception that inspects descendant paths exists only around addressed access.
limitations.addressed-views: at(guard, [k]) produced an addressed view that repeated the guard's check when composed again. Structural selection returns the selected node itself, so a rebuilt tree retains child identity and nothing is wrapped twice.
limitations.owner-only-parts: Decision 0006 kept construction parts with their owner and gave callers send-only access. Decision 0012 makes decomposition part of the full tree; a caller that must not see structure receives an AddressedWire bridge or a single own Wire instead.
limitations.addressed-mount: Mount/mount is bitruntime's addressed routing operator: child-only, typed by a native map of Endpoints and validated on send. Its recorded gaps remain accurate observations of that operator. Tree construction is Compose/compose.

requirements.note: Own value at [] beside complete children, empty keys, the literal slash key and both Unicode spellings. Adds the binary key and a present refusing node.
[alias, x] and [a, b, x, y] were delivered to leaf with a suffix; in the full tree both are missing.
Nested and concatenated selection reach the same node; selection returns that node itself.
Selections through [alias] then [x] were delivered to leaf with [x]; in the full tree they are missing.
Meaning sharpened: missing paths are missing, not refused, and [empty] is a present node whose own refuses. No own value is invoked as fallback.
Meaning sharpened: the two sends were indistinguishable refusals; selection now distinguishes a present refusing node from a missing one.
Meaning sharpened: an omitted or renamed child is missing rather than refused.
Tree paths are bytes and have no invalid form; an ill-formed addressed segment is refused by the bridge before any own Wire.
The captured cancellation is now the requester's cancel frame through tree access, routed by the far dispatcher's captured traversal; the late reply returns to the original return capability.
Meaning sharpened: [missing] is missing, while [], [a], [""] and [empty] are present nodes whose own refuses.
[alias] then [x, y] reached leaf with a suffix.
Meaning changed: a key outside the UTF-8 image is a valid tree key, reachable structurally.
It is unreachable through the bitwire/1 bridge, which never decodes or normalizes.
The historical case refused a cyclic description in the test harness. Construction itself now refuses a child graph that contains a cycle.
Closing the serving dispatcher releases its routes, never the borrowed endpoint or the served tree.
The direct send to leaf with [x].
Retained primitive state survives reconstruction because reconstruction keeps the capability.
Rebuilding from selected children retains their identity.

gaps.note: Public Compose/compose(own, children) takes the own value. The ledger entries remain true of addressed Mount, which is child-only by design.
No tree key is invalid. The bridge carries the exact UTF-8 image and refuses ill-formed segments before any primitive.

ledgerLimitations.note: Tree children are DeixisNode values whose own is a send-only Wire; construction needs no receive attachment or closure authority.
Decision 0012 makes decomposition public; restricted callers receive the bridge.
